scopeNotes: Rust entries conservatively cover every exact current Cargo.lock package, including build-only and conditional-platform crates, and retain previously recorded original legal documents; they are not a claim that every entry ships in the Windows executable.
Frontend entries cover the installed runtime dependency closure from package.json; TypeScript, Vite, pnpm and CLI/build-tool executables are not redistributed.
Original project code is MIT; each third-party component keeps its own original terms.
Build tools, LLVM, xwin, Windows SDK and CRT toolchain payloads are excluded from these distribution resources.

Installer-specific NSIS3.11 stub/compression, standard plug-in and Tauri0.5.3 plug-in notices are separate from the application Cargo lockfile inventory; exact prebuilt plug-in transitive/toolchain resolution was not published and is not claimed.
